title: What If Leaded Gasoline Had Never Been Banned?
subject: car exhaust

scenes.text: What if cars still ran on leaded gas? We already ran that experiment.
For decades, American gasoline carried lead, and the exhaust settled into the air kids breathed.
Leaded gasoline for cars was banned in the United States in 1996.
A 2022 study found over 170 million Americans alive in 2015 had harmful lead levels as kids.
Its estimate: about 824 million IQ points lost, nearly three per person on average.
People born in the 1960s and 70s were hit hardest, with losses of up to six points.
